environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. Database connections routed through PgBouncer 1.22 configured with pool_mode=statement and max_client_conn=100, server_idle_timeout=60. PostgreSQL 16.1 with custom configuration: default_transaction_isolation set to 'serializable' via ALTER SYSTEM. PgBouncer's statement-level pooling mode forces each SQL statement into its own server-side transaction context, which combined with PostgreSQL's serializable isolation causes automatic serialization failure (40001) on any concurrent read-write anomaly against the same rows. The application's asyncpg driver surfaces these as SerializationError exceptions which propagate as 500s. Additionally, pg_hba.conf restricts the application role to max 2 concurrent connections per user via connection_limit parameter on the role (ALTER ROLE app CONNECTION LIMIT 2), creating natural serialization of requests at the connection layer.
